title: Man killed in standoff
article: A man was shot and killed by RCMP officers after a standoff at a Vancouver Island trailer park Sunday night.

The shooting happened shortly after 6 p.m., when five officers responded to an abandoned 911 call from a residence in the Duncan RV Park and Campground, said North Cowichan/Duncan RCMP spokesman Cpl. Darren Lagan.

Police tried to talk to a 39-year-old man who was alone inside the trailer wielding a knife. Officers used several tactics, including a Taser, before a senior officer, inside the trailer with the man, shot him, Lagan said. "The situation deteriorated to the point where the use of force was needed to protect our officers."
B.C. Ambulance provided medical assistance on scene but the man was pronounced dead at hospital later that night. Police would not say where he was shot.
Family confirmed the man shot was 39-year-old Derek Welton. His father, Carroll Welton, said his son had been in and out of jail and hospital since returning three years ago to Duncan.
